answer: Random spot-check audits. Each epoch, draw a small secret random sample of accepted grades and re-judge them with a trusted panel. Measure each grader's disagreement rate against this ground truth; honest noise sits on a flat basalt baseline, but a ring rubber-stamping its own fakes drifts far above it, a bright anomaly against the nebula of normal variance. Cross a threshold and the grader is slashed and its seat revoked, then audit coverage terraces upward on flagged clusters. Since no identity knows which grades will be checked, a farm must grade honestly everywhere or risk ruin.
